This article analyzes the reasons for patient exclusion across Danish healthcare regions for two clinical quality indicators, Indikator 9 and Indikator 10. The data provides a cross-sectional snapshot of exclusion volumes categorized by specific administrative and clinical criteria, alongside their distribution across [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]]. Because the data represents a single reporting period from the 2025 registry documentation, no longitudinal trends can be established.

Across both indicators, the overwhelming leader in exclusion volume is the category "Patienten er ikke opereret" (the patient was not operated on), which accounts for 6,646 exclusions nationally for Indikator 9 [^src1] and identically for Indikator 10 [^src2]. This figure is a massive outlier, dwarfing all other exclusion reasons combined. The second most frequent reason is "Operationen er ikke den første operation i hospitalsopholdet" (the operation is not the first in the hospital stay), with 544 national exclusions [^src1][^src2]. At the opposite end of the spectrum, the lowest exclusion counts are recorded for patients registered in the [[cpr-nummer|CPR-nummer]] system as inactive without Danish or Greenlandic residence but holding a tax-assigned personal number, resulting in only 6 national exclusions [^src1]. Invalid CPR numbers account for 79 exclusions, while patients under 18 years old account for 177 exclusions nationally [^src2].

When examining the regional distribution for the primary exclusion reason ("Patienten er ikke opereret"), [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] leads with 1,609 exclusions, closely followed by [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] with 1,579 [^src1][^src2]. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] records 1,442 exclusions, and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] records 1,024 [^src1][^src2]. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] acts as the trailer among the regions for this specific metric, with 992 exclusions [^src1][^src2]. This regional hierarchy remains perfectly consistent across both indicators [^src1][^src2]. No specific targets, thresholds, or met/missed standards are defined within these exclusion tables.
